18997.biography:
Bryce Dallas Howard (nata il 2 marzo 1981) è un'attrice, regista e produttrice statunitense. Figlia del celebre regista Ron Howard, ha sviluppato fin da giovane una passione per il cinema, studiando recitazione alla Tisch School of the Arts della New York University e iniziando la sua carriera nel teatro prima di affermarsi sul grande schermo.

Ha ottenuto il suo primo ruolo di grande rilievo grazie al regista M. Night Shyamalan, che l'ha scelta per interpretare Ivy Walker nel thriller psicologico The Village (2004) e successivamente come protagonista del film fantasy-thriller Lady in the Water (2006). La sua carriera è proseguita con film come As You Like It (2006), Spider-Man 3 (2007), Terminator Salvation (2009), The Twilight Saga: Eclipse (2010), 50 e 50 (2011) e The Help (2011), ottenendo grande apprezzamento dalla critica.

Ha raggiunto la fama internazionale interpretando Claire Dearing nella saga Jurassic World, ruolo ripreso in Jurassic World (2015), Jurassic World - Il regno distrutto (2018) e Jurassic World - Il dominio (2022). Parallelamente alla carriera di attrice, ha intrapreso anche quella di regista dirigendo episodi di serie come The Mandalorian, The Book of Boba Fett e Star Wars: Skeleton Crew, oltre a diversi cortometraggi.

Grazie alla sua versatilità davanti e dietro la macchina da presa, Bryce Dallas Howard è considerata una delle figure più interessanti del cinema contemporaneo.

19509.biography:
Jessica Yu (Chinese: 虞琳敏; pinyin: Yú Línmǐn) is an American film director, writer, producer, and editor. She has directed documentary films, dramatic films, and television shows.

Yu won the Academy Award for Best Documentary Short Subject in 1996 for Breathing Lessons: The Life and Work of Mark O'Brien (1996). Yu's film Last Call at the Oasis (2012) is based on Alex Prud'homme's Ripple Effect. Her more recent films have been Misconception (2014), ForEveryone.Net (2016), a documentary film about the inventor of the World Wide Web, Sir Tim Berners-Lee, and a Netflix comedy Maria Bamford: Old Baby (2017). In 2019, Yu was nominated for an Emmy Award for "Outstanding Direction for a Limited Series, Movie, or Dramatic Special" for the Fosse/Verdon episode "Glory".

9013.biography:
Kevin McKidd (born 9 August 1973) is a Scottish television and film actor and director. He is known for his prominent television roles, including his performances as Lucius Vorenus in Rome, as Poseidon in Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, and as Dr. Owen Hunt in Grey's Anatomy.

He has also appeared in films such as Trainspotting, Bedrooms and Hallways, Kingdom of Heaven, The Last Legion, Hannibal Rising, The Acid House, Made of Honor and had the lead role in the cult-classic British horror film Dog Soldiers.

McKidd has done voice work and voiced the character of Jezz Torrent, flame haired lead singer of the fictional Scottish hard rock band Love Fist in the video games "Grand Theft Auto: Vice City". He also voiced Captain "Soap" MacTavish in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2.
